decisions: Classify by actual information carrier, not text count or genre; support per-segment exceptions.
All intelligible dialogue, monologue, narration and spoken CTA require translation in every class. Preserve music/nonverbal FX by default.
Infer multi-character retrieval only from distinct recorded known character IDs; do not invent identities, gender or short-drama genre.
Eligible required methods survive optional method limit; existing source/locale/feature/mode conditions stay binding.
Versioned new-request assessment records primary type, evidence and per-domain method/alternative/switch/stop reasons; Agent judges semantics.
Fast plans freeze selected knowledge, actual choices and use-feedback dependencies. Legacy plans retain missing-record status until re-registration.
Full decoded audio measurement replaces 181-second truncation. Technical evidence does not establish speech semantics or acceptance.
metadata_review: retrieval_role=required is a selection guarantee, not mandatory execution. Source-neutral preparation is conditional on actual onscreen text. Source/locale scopes and method/evidence bytes remain unchanged.
proof_boundary: User authorization and developer method review; regression/synthetic checks only. No new customer-video quality or native listening acceptance.
